_comment: The job scripts/install_cron.py creates — do not hand-edit cron/jobs.json, it is live scheduler state. no_agent: the scheduler runs the script and delivers its stdout verbatim; empty stdout = a silent run; no model is called. fieldnotes-watch.py must live in $HERMES_HOME/scripts/ (scripts/install.py copies it).
